question: The World Happiness Report, 2025, ranked which of following countries as the happiest in the world for the seventh consecutive year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Finland has been consistently ranked as the happiest country in the world by the World Happiness Report since 2018.
 
• The rankings are based on factors like social support, income, healthy life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption.
